create_LSTMHistorySummarizationModule: create an LSTMHistorySummarizationModule with observation and action dimensions for history summarization
summarize_history_method: summarize past observations and actions into a hidden representation using the LSTM module
get_history_method: get the current history buffer tensor from the LSTM history summarization module
reset_history_method: reset the history buffer to zeros in the LSTM history summarization module
compare_modules_method: compare two LSTMHistorySummarizationModule instances and return a string describing their differences
